name: WC AI Summarizer
author: Praveen Kumar

sections.description:
WC AI Summarizer is a free WordPress plugin developed by Wild Creek Web Studio. It adds buttons to published public posts so readers can request a summary in their preferred AI assistant.

No API keys or AI subscriptions are required to install the plugin. The assistant generates the summary on its own website.

Supported AI platforms

  • ChatGPT
  • Claude
  • Perplexity
  • Google AI Mode
  • Gemini
  • Grok
  • Microsoft Copilot

Enable or disable each platform independently. Microsoft Copilot is off by default.

Button appearance

Open Settings > WC AI Summarizer to customise the appearance.

Button styles

  • Compact: Smaller buttons that wrap to fit the available space.
  • Standard: Larger, flexible buttons.
  • Large: A wider grid of buttons.

Other appearance settings

  • Alignment: Left, centre or right.
  • Show provider icons: Display available bundled icons beside provider names.
  • Container border: Show or hide the border.
  • Container background: Use the theme background or white.
  • Heading: Edit the text above the buttons.

Prompt templates

Choose from six options:

  • Simple Summary (default)
  • Summary and Key Takeaways
  • Summary and Expertise
  • Detailed Summary
  • Question and Answer
  • Custom Prompt

Edit any predefined prompt or reset it to its original text. Existing saved prompts remain unchanged when upgrading.

Default prompt

Summarize the article at {post_url} in clear and concise language.

Available placeholders

  • {post_url}: Public post URL.
  • {post_title}: Post title.
  • {site_name}: Website name.

Keep the post URL in prompts that ask an assistant to read the original article.

Display and placement

  • Before post: Display buttons above the article.
  • After post: Display buttons below the article (default).
  • Shortcode only: Insert [wc_ai_summarizer] where needed.
  • Individual post exclusions: Hide buttons using the option in the post editor.

Floating Summarize button

Enable the floating shortcut on mobile, desktop or both.

The shortcut appears when the inline buttons are out of view. It opens a panel containing the enabled AI platforms, including manual prompt copying when Gemini or Copilot is enabled.

Learn more on the WC AI Summarizer plugin page.

External services and privacy

Direct prompt links

ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Mode and Grok receive the configured prompt in the destination URL when a reader follows their link.

Clipboard and manual copying

Gemini and Microsoft Copilot open in a new tab. The plugin attempts to copy the prompt to the clipboard so readers can paste it into the assistant. If clipboard access fails, readers can copy the prompt manually from the field below the buttons.

Data shared with providers

The prompt may include the post URL, title or website name. The plugin makes no server-side AI requests and does not send the article body.

Providers may require readers to sign in. They may also be unable to access a page or change how their links handle prompts.

Each provider applies its own terms and privacy policy:

  • ChatGPT (Terms, Privacy)
  • Claude (Terms, Privacy)
  • Perplexity (Terms, Privacy)
  • Google AI Mode (Terms, Privacy)
  • Gemini (Terms, Privacy)
  • Grok (Terms, Privacy)
  • Microsoft Copilot (Terms, Privacy)
sections.installation:
Requires WordPress 7.1 or later and PHP 8.3 or later.

  1. Upload the plugin ZIP through Plugins > Add New Plugin > Upload Plugin, or upload the plugin folder to wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate WC AI Summarizer from Plugins.
  3. Open Settings > WC AI Summarizer.
  4. Select the AI platforms, button appearance, prompt and placement.
  5. Save your settings and test the buttons on a published public post.

For manual placement, select Shortcode only and add [wc_ai_summarizer] to a Shortcode block.
sections.faq:
Where are the buttons displayed?

On published public posts. Pages, archives, previews, password-protected posts and posts excluded in the editor do not show the buttons.

Do I need an API key?

No. Readers use the selected provider’s website, which may require its own account.

Can I customise the prompt?

Yes. Choose a predefined template and edit it, or write your own prompt.

Why are Gemini and Copilot asking me to paste a prompt?

These providers open separately. The plugin attempts to copy the prompt on click. If automatic copying is unavailable, return to the post and use the manual prompt field.

Does the plugin display the summary on my website?

No. The selected AI provider generates and displays the summary on its own website.

Does deleting the plugin remove its settings?

WordPress removes the plugin files. Saved settings and per-post exclusions remain in the database.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Improve compatibility with WordPress theme styles across all three button layouts.
  • Fix oversized provider icons, inconsistent button dimensions and broken provider labels.

1.0.1

  • Add Perplexity and Google AI Mode as separate providers.
  • Add editable prompt templates and appearance settings.
  • Preserve existing settings and exclusions.

1.0.0

  • Initial release with configurable AI links, shortcode placement, post exclusions and clipboard fallback for Gemini and Copilot.
